title: Drop the test-only STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_INSTRUCTION root export from the in-process driver
task:
Problem: packages/subagent/subagent-in-process-driver/src/index.ts:44 re-exports `STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_INSTRUCTION` (packages/subagent/subagent-in-process-driver/src/structured.ts:26, used by the driver itself at structured.ts:102). Its only importer outside src is this package's own test; no other package, app or example uses it and the README does not name it. `STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_TOOL` next to it has cross-package consumers and stays. The proposed prune note classifies test-only root exports as SDK surface without an owner.

Required: remove the root re-export on index.ts:44, keep the constant exported from structured.ts for its same-package caller, and change the test to import `../src/structured.ts` (package-local test imports are the existing convention); the model-visible instruction text stays pinned verbatim by that test. No behavior change.

Constraints: mechanical, local edit under the Agent Note exemption; do not touch other exports.
